contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, cloud demand and healthcare, but several five-channel scores rely heavily on sentiment or affiliation rather than hard operating signals. With no scored track record yet, conviction stays modest and only non-extended names with multiple distinct channels merit action.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MRK combines ten Phase 3 starts [clinical_phase3_start], an FDA label-expansion signal [fda_label_expansion], substantial lobbying activity [lobbying], and a favorable Trump-linked signal [trump]. These channels span pipeline, regulation and policy access, but four clinical halts materially weaken the read; the stock remains below the extended threshold.
second_order: Large-cap pharma R&D theme — multiple Phase 3 starts imply sustained demand for trials, manufacturing and regulatory services [clinical_phase3_start]
Clinical-research services theme — a broad late-stage pipeline increases trial execution needs, though the pack names no specific beneficiary [clinical_phase3_start]
ALS-therapy ecosystem — Senate reporting of S4472 could support research programs, but the pack does not establish a direct MRK linkage [bill:S4472]

falsifier.text: Clinical halts broaden or the reported label-expansion opportunity fails to produce meaningful commercial uptake.

signals.thesis: MSFT's alignment is operational rather than purely promotional: strong app engagement [app_demand], broad developer activity [github_momentum], and a large patent cluster [patent_cluster] coincide with its factual partnership connection to Sam Altman [actor:Sam Altman]. The channels support durable ecosystem demand, although they do not establish incremental revenue growth by themselves; the shares are not extended.
second_order: NVDA — expanding cloud and developer workloads imply continued accelerator demand, subject to near-term earnings risk [github_momentum]
AMD — broader AI-cloud deployment can support demand for alternative compute platforms [github_momentum]
Cloud software ecosystem — high app engagement and developer activity point to downstream tooling and infrastructure demand [app_demand][github_momentum]

falsifier.text: App engagement and developer activity weaken together without corresponding growth in commercial cloud demand.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
